cues.en: In this presentation, I'll present my breakthrough research on solving computational problems using PowerPoint. I will explore to what extent PowerPoint can replace conventional programming languages, as well as the benefits and limitations of using PowerPoint for such purposes. But first, a quick disclaimer. This presentation is not sponsored or endorsed by any real or hypothetical corporation located in Redmont, Washington. The views and opinions expressed are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect those of any such corporation should one exist.
cues.zh: 在这场演讲中，我将展示我的突破性研究：用 PowerPoint 解决计算问题。我将探讨 PowerPoint 在多大程度上能替代传统编程语言，以及将其用于此类目的的优势和局限。但在开始前，先做个免责声明。本演讲未获得位于华盛顿州雷蒙德市的任何真实或假设公司的赞助或认可。所表达的观点和看法仅代表作者本人，不一定反映此类公司（如果存在的话）的观点。

cues.en: Only trained PowerPoint professionals should attempt to reproduce the results of this research, and the author will not be held responsible for any material, physical, or emotional damages caused by such attempts. So with that out of the way, we can proceed to the background. So as you may know, PowerPoint has hyperlinks and animations, which can be used to add interactivity to your presentations. So we have links here. And then we also have animations, which are particularly interesting because you can trigger them in different orders.
cues.zh: 只有受过训练的 PowerPoint 专业人士才应尝试复现本研究的结果，作者对由此类尝试造成的任何物质、身体或精神损害概不负责。说完这些，我们就可以进入背景介绍了。大家可能知道，PowerPoint 支持超链接和动画，可用来为演示文稿增添互动性。这里有链接。接着我们还有动画，这特别有意思，因为你能以不同的顺序触发它们。

cues.en: So you can use these to make interesting things like applications, games, you know, typical things that you'd make in a slideshow editor. But until recently, it has been unproven as to whether you can do all things using PowerPoint, whether you can solve every computational problem with a dedicated PowerPoint file. And this is largely because in order to prove such a claim, you would need to create a Turing machine that runs in PowerPoint, or you'd have to be able to show that every Turing machine can be run within PowerPoint. So without further ado,
cues.zh: 所以你可以用这些来制作有趣的东西，比如应用程序、游戏，懂的都懂，就是那些你通常会在幻灯片编辑器里做的东西。但直到最近，人们都无法证明你是否能用 PowerPoint 做任何事情，是否能用专门的 PowerPoint 文件解决每一个计算问题。这主要是因为要证明这一点，你必须造出一个在 PowerPoint 中运行的图灵机，或者能够证明任何图灵机都能在 PowerPoint 中运行。话不多说，请看：

cues.en: the calendar recognizing Turing machine. So here we have a Turing machine that decides the language calendars of even length. So you can see that like a normal Turing machine, we can move this tape that's implemented completely with animations. There are no macros or anything else. So I can write the tape, of course, so we'll give it a simple input like this. And of course, I can also execute the Turing machine. So here we have the Turing machine's current state.
cues.zh: 识别日历语言的图灵机。这里我们有一个图灵机，用来判定偶数长度的日历语言。大家可以看到，就像普通的图灵机一样，我们可以移动这条完全用动画实现的纸带。这里没有任何宏或其他东西。当然我也可以在纸带上写入，我们就给它输入一个像这样的简单内容。当然，我也能执行这个图灵机。这里显示的是图灵机的当前状态。

cues.en: And in order to continue execution, unfortunately, this doesn't happen automatically. It needs a little bit of encouragement. The user has to click on each orange region. Now, you might be concerned here that I'm making decisions whenever I'm clicking on this, but the way that this PowerPoint is set up, every other area is blocked. So I can click randomly, essentially, and the PowerPoint will just advance its computation. So that was the input 11. So this should end up being accepted.
cues.zh: 而为了继续执行，遗憾的是，这并不会自动进行。它需要一点“鼓励”。用户必须点击每个橙色区域。大家现在可能会担心，我每次点击都在做决策，但这个 PowerPoint 的设置方式是把其他区域全封锁了。所以从本质上讲，我可以瞎点，而这个 PowerPoint 照样会推进它的计算。刚刚输入的是 11。所以最终结果应该是被接受。

cues.en: And we can see that it does indeed end on an accepting state. And I could rerun that with another input, and it would reject accordingly depending on what it is. So this is nice, but what we'd really like to be able to do is run any Turing machine in PowerPoint. Fortunately, this is easy because the PowerPoint Turing machine is programmed entirely using punch cards.
cues.zh: 我们可以看到，它确实会停在接受状态。我也可以用另一个输入重新运行，它会根据具体输入相应地拒绝。这很不错，但我们真正想做的是在 PowerPoint 里运行任意图灵机。幸运的是，这很容易，因为 PowerPoint 图灵机完全是用打孔卡编程的。

cues.en: So for example, this card says that whenever the Turing machine is in state 0 and it reads a 1, then it should write a blank, move to the right, and then move to state 2. But if we change where these holes are located, we can make the Turing machine do something else, and essentially can take any transition function of any other Turing machine. All of this is accomplished using over 1,600 animations and around 700 objects. The Kotlin Turing machine offers a number of advantages over alternative programming languages.
cues.zh: 比如，这张卡说明：只要图灵机处于状态 0 并读到 1，它就应该写入空白符、向右移动，然后转到状态 2。但如果我们改变这些孔的位置，就能让图灵机做别的事，本质上可以套用任何其他图灵机的转移函数。所有这些是用 1,600 多个动画和大约 700 个对象实现的。用 Kotlin 实现的图灵机相比其他编程语言方案有不少优势。

cues.en: offering cross-platform support running on both mobile devices and both commercially relevant desktop operating systems. In addition, its drag-and-drop programming means there's no text and no syntax errors. But most importantly, you can use themes, word art, and transitions that PowerPoint is infamous for in your code. It requires asymptotically fewer auto shapes than when implemented in alternative slideshow editors, definitively proving PowerPoint to be exponentially more capable than competing software.
cues.zh: 它提供跨平台支持，既能运行在移动设备上，也能运行在两个商业上重要的桌面操作系统上。此外，它的拖放式编程意味着没有文本，也没有语法错误。但最重要的是，你可以在代码里使用 PowerPoint 臭名昭著的主题、艺术字和切换效果。相比在其他幻灯片编辑器中的实现，它所需的自选图形数量在渐近意义上更少，从而确凿证明 PowerPoint 的能力比竞争软件强出指数级。

cues.en: But perhaps most notably, the PowerPoint Turing machine shows the PowerPoint iOS app is in violation of Apple's App Store guidelines. It shows that PowerPoint can emulate alternative apps and execute arbitrary code. In the future, I'd like to research making PowerPoint code more scalable and optimized so that one day every application you run on your computer can be run within PowerPoint.
cues.zh: 但也许最值得注意的是，PowerPoint 图灵机表明 PowerPoint iOS 应用违反了 Apple 的 App Store 指南。它表明 PowerPoint 能模拟其他应用并执行任意代码。未来，我想研究如何让 PowerPoint 代码更具可扩展性、更优化，以便有一天你在电脑上运行的每个应用都能在 PowerPoint 里运行。
